decision: Not accepted for tests yet; documentary corrections only, source/test pins unchanged.
findings: Bootstrap /dev/null and source-loader FDs are acquired before MainRoot and claimed resource-free on failure; outer containment covers run only. Track early FDs from before acquisition and verify close before safe early exit.
Permanent OWNED link exception conflicts with the prior all-slots-empty contract; reconcile borrowed stdio with verified link retirement, without clearing an active reader or uncertain slot.

hold rounds is a finite-return knob on the production hold; use finite step/decision testing and non-returning runtime hold. Reinstalling handlers and tight retry on failing wait must not escape or spin.
Reader lock is described inside read_exact, permitting release between INIT header and body. Public read_init/read_control must hold one reader lock for the whole frame.
MAIN output adds an unnecessary unaccepted protocol extension and post-predicate IO. Preserve existing driver-only metadata wire and caps, no new MAIN event.
WorkerSession.close does not universally convert BaseException into WorkerSessionError: _exclusive can let it escape, _cleanup catches internally and returns HELD. State this exactly.
Python installs default SIGINT before script; do not assume early signals ignored. Primary docs checked main-thread handlers, thread exception output, join/is_alive and namespace init behavior.
effects: No tests/source or native execution; design-only. Main implementation/test still absent.
